title: Northgate Delivery & Installation Extended-Distance Charge and Its Posting Tool
content:
An appointment whose road miles from the delivering club exceed the service level's included radius owes an extended-distance charge under Northgate Delivery & Installation, posted as one extended-distance entry dated the posting date with the appointment's currently booked delivery date as its service date. The entry carries as its units the appointment's road miles beyond the included radius. An appointment whose road miles do not exceed the included radius owes no extended-distance charge.

The road miles are those recorded on the appointment, computed from the delivering club when the appointment was booked; the included radius is that of the appointment's service level.

## When the charge is owed

| Road miles on the appointment | Extended-distance charge | Units on the entry |
|---|---|---|
| Not more than the included radius | Not owed | — |
| More than the included radius | Owed, as one extended-distance entry | The road miles beyond the included radius |

**Hypothetical appointments.** With an included radius of 50 miles, an appointment recorded at 50 road miles owes no extended-distance charge; one recorded at 63 road miles owes it, and its entry carries 13 miles as its units. The service date on the entry is the delivery date the appointment is booked for at the time of posting, and the entry is dated the day it is posted.

## Posting tool: `post_extended_distance_charge_120a0e6d`

**What it does.** Member services adds one extended-distance fee entry to a member's delivery appointment for the road miles its delivery address lies beyond the radius the service level includes. On success the appointment's fee history shows a new extended-distance charge for the amount given, posted today and tied to the appointment date given, and the amount becomes part of the delivery fees the member pays for that appointment.

**How it is invoked.** This is an agent-side tool. The representative unlocks `post_extended_distance_charge_120a0e6d` and then calls it.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `customer_id` | The customer reference number of the member who owns the appointment, as returned by the customer lookup and shown on the appointment | Identifier |
| `delivery_id` | The reference number of the delivery appointment being charged, as returned by the delivery appointment lookup | Identifier |
| `service_date` | The appointment date the charge relates to | YYYY-MM-DD calendar date, no time or time zone; never empty |
| `miles_beyond_radius` | The billing units of the entry: the appointment's road miles beyond the service level's included radius | Whole non-negative integer |
| `amount` | The extended-distance charge to post, in USD | 2 decimal places, always positive; stored rounded to the cent |

**Return.** On success the tool returns a description of the posted entry: `status` ("posted"), `delivery_charge_id` (the new fee entry's reference number), `delivery_id` (the appointment charged), `charge_type` (always `extended_distance`), `units` (the miles beyond the radius recorded, an integer), `amount` (the charge in USD, 2 decimal places), `event_date` (the posting date, YYYY-MM-DD) and `service_date` (the appointment date the charge relates to, YYYY-MM-DD).

**Hypothetical call.** For an appointment booked for 2026-03-14 whose road miles lie 13 beyond its radius, the call carries `service_date` 2026-03-14 and `miles_beyond_radius` 13, together with the member's `customer_id`, the appointment's `delivery_id` and the `amount` of the charge; the receipt echoes those values with `status` "posted" and today's date as `event_date`.
